steps.en: Start APISIX and its configuration store with the quickstart
steps.zh: 用 quickstart 启动 APISIX 与配置存储

steps.en: Runs the gateway on port 9080 and stores dynamic configuration in etcd
steps.zh: 在 9080 端口运行网关，并把动态配置存入 etcd

steps.en: Declare a route, its upstream nodes, and the plugins that should run
steps.zh: 声明路由、上游节点和要运行的插件

steps.en: Watches the configuration and applies route and plugin changes without a restart
steps.zh: 监听配置，在不重启时应用路由与插件变更

steps.en: Send client traffic to the gateway route
steps.zh: 把客户端流量发到网关路由

steps.en: Matches the route, runs its plugins, and proxies to a healthy upstream
steps.zh: 匹配路由、执行插件，并代理到健康上游

value.en: Routing and shared API policy change at the gateway without redeploying backend services
value.zh: 路由与共享 API 策略在网关生效，无需重新部署后端服务
